title: Amanita muscaria ESP research at the Round Table

tellings.quote: and this was also the research he was doing at the Roundtable was people, you know, taking a certain type of mushroom in this instance the Amanita muscaria, you know, gives people ESP abilities and they did extensive research on that there.

plain: In the 1950s a private research group called the Round Table Foundation, in Rockland, Maine, studied the mind and unusual mental powers. A researcher named Greg Malatzi, on Jesse Michels's podcast, says the scientist who ran it did extensive tests in which people took a red and white mushroom called Amanita muscaria to see if it gave them ESP, meaning extrasensory perception, abilities like reading minds, work also described in a book called The Sacred Mushroom. If true, it would mean serious researchers were trying to unlock psychic powers with drugs.
